name: National Geographic Society grants
summary: Grants to individuals for science, conservation, storytelling, education and technology projects, now offered through time-bound requests for proposals that each set their own scope, budget, eligibility and deadline.
reporting: Project leaders must submit a final report and media for each grant they led before they can apply to lead a new project.

applicant_types.quote: We fund individuals working on projects in science, conservation, storytelling, education and technology that align with one or more of our focus areas.

access.quote: All applications must be completed and submitted through the National Geographic Funding Portal.

window.quote: Our grantmaking is now driven by distinct, time-bound RFPs designed to address specific environmental, cultural and scientific priorities.

reporting.quote: You must submit a final report and media from any previous National Geographic Society grants for which you were the leader before applying to lead a new project.
